name: Chongqing Gas Group Corporation Ltd.
summary: Chongqing Gas Group Corporation Ltd., headquartered in Chongqing, China, operates as a diversified energy enterprise offering a comprehensive array of gas-related services. These services encompass the design, production, installation, maintenance, sale, and management of gas systems, alongside expert technical consultation. The company also manages the entire pipeline network, overseeing gas storage, transportation, supply, distribution, and commercialization. Beyond these core operations, its portfolio extends to providing heating, cooling, and integrated heat and power solutions, fostering high-tech gas development, offering pipeline anti-corrosion treatments, and retailing gas appliances. Significantly, it serves approximately 5.12 million natural gas customers across 25 districts and counties within the Chongqing municipality.
